newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine industrial output up 9.9 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Argentine industrial output up 9.9 pct in June.

text.p: Argentina's industrial output in June was up 9.9 percent on the same month last year, according to preliminary data released Wednesday by the private consultancy FIEL.
The government's industrial output data is due Thursday, with private analysts polled by Reuters forecasting on average a seven percent increase in production from June to June.

FIEL said industrial production fell 4.1 percent in June from May this year. For the second quarter of the year, output was up 8.2 percent on the same period last year, a similar figure to the first quarter's 8.1 percent increase.

FIEL also carries out a monthly survey of industry's outlook on prospects, which in June showed 19 percent were confident their situation would improve in coming months and 81 percent expected there to be no change.
Six percent said demand was encouraging, 90 percent said it was "normal" and four percent said it was discouraging.
Usage of installed capacity in June was 76.4 percent, up 0.9 percent on May this year and up 1.4 percent on June 1996.
